buyer_attachments.text: Frozen offer requires: brand Logitech, model logitech-mx-master-4, colour Graphite, condition New, retail box with Logitech branding EU version, product only. Delivered: wrong serial (SN4X9K2P1Q8R vs claimed SNFDFA2B97B9), no hologram sticker, box missing CE/WEEE and EU plug leaflet, material finish matte-grey not Graphite, haptic feedback absent. Non-conformity on model authenticity, condition, colour/finish and accessories/packaging. AG3 applies; merchant liable for refund.

buyer_photos.description: Underside of delivered mouse: serial label clearly reads SN4X9K2P1Q8R (not SNFDFA2B97B9). Print is blurry, no Logitech hologram foil. Graphite paint uneven.
Opened retail box interior: no CE/WEEE marks, no EU leaflet, cheap cardboard; mouse plastic looks lighter than genuine Graphite MX Master 4; logo off-centre.
Close-up of scroll wheel and MagSpeed area: no haptic feedback module visible; seam gaps and mould lines inconsistent with authentic Logitech MX Master 4 Graphite.

pre_gate.rationale: The hash-chained offer is a new genuine Logitech MX Master 4 (Graphite) in an EU Logitech retail box at EUR 115. A 0.18 kg parcel was signed for on 2026-11-07 without a contents inspection, and the merchant's packing serial is self-reported and unrebutted only by a generic denial. Same-day buyer photos and the authenticity upload show a different serial, no hologram, missing EU marks and counterfeit build quality, so on the balance of probabilities the unit does not conform and AG3 requires a merchant refund of EUR 115.

key_findings.value: Parcel delivered 2026-11-07 at 0.18 kg and signed for; carrier did not inspect contents

Counterfeit relative to genuine Logitech MX Master 4: photographed serial SN4X9K2P1Q8R conflicts with self-reported packed serial SNFDFA2B97B9, label print is unofficial, and the buyer authenticity upload reports both serials absent from the MX Master 4 registry
Does not match the frozen images of a new undamaged graphite Logitech mouse in an EU retail box: no hologram, missing CE/WEEE marks, cheap box, off-centre logo, uneven finish and mould defects
Not the offered New genuine unit: blurry non-hologram serial label, seam and mould defects inconsistent with a new authentic MX Master 4
